title: useSelectedDocument throws NoSelectedDocumentError while useSelectedDocumentSafe returns undefined
content:
Three hooks read the selected document, and they differ only in how they handle absence.

`useSelectedDocument()` resolves the selected node id, calls `useDocumentById`, and throws if nothing came back:

```ts
const [document, dispatch] = useDocumentById(selectedDocumentId);
if (!document) throw new NoSelectedDocumentError();
return [document, dispatch] as const;
```

The error message is self-documenting: *"There is no selected document. Did you mean to call 'useSelectedDocumentSafe' instead?"* Because it throws, `document` is non-nullable in the returned tuple — that is the whole point of the variant, and it means an `if (!document)` guard after the call is dead code.

`useSelectedDocumentSafe()` is the same lookup with the throw removed — it is literally `return useDocumentById(selectedDocumentId)` — so it yields `[PHDocument | undefined, dispatch]`. Reach for it whenever "no document selected" is a state your component should render, not an invariant violation. Note that `undefined` is also what you get while a real document is still loading, so the Safe variant cannot distinguish "nothing selected" from "not here yet".

`useSelectedDocumentOfType(documentType)` layers a type check on top. It throws `NoSelectedDocumentError` when no document is selected and `DocumentTypeMismatchError` when the selected document is a different type. It has one quirk: passing a `null`/`undefined` `documentType` returns an empty array (`never[]`) rather than throwing, so the hook can be called conditionally on a type that is not known yet.

**Documentation caveat:** the React Hooks reference page attaches a copy-pasted *"Throws: NoSelectedDocumentError"* block to the `useSelectedDocumentSafe` section, and its example calls the non-Safe hook. That contradicts both the same section's own prose and the source. The Safe variant does not throw.

_Source: packages/reactor-browser/src/hooks/selected-document.ts and src/errors.ts, cross-checked against apps/academy/docs/academy/04-Reference/05-EditorsUI/01-ReactHooks.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45)._
description: Pick the Safe variant when "no document selected" is a legitimate state. useSelectedDocumentOfType additionally throws DocumentTypeMismatchError on a type mismatch.
